brief: TOP PICK: AI Engineering education (opp 9) - Learning paths are the #1 unmet need as companies scramble to hire AI engineers. Build the Pluralsight for AI engineering.
Agent orchestration is the infrastructure gap - deploying and managing fleets of autonomous coding agents is unsolved. Stablelyai/orca shows the demand.
Codebase intelligence is breakout - Graphify-Labs turns code into queryable knowledge graphs. This is novel and defensible.
Self-improving agents are emerging - NousResearch/hermes-agent signals the next wave: agents that learn and optimize over time.
TIMING: Agent frameworks are exploding. Model routing is commoditizing. The money is in orchestration, education, and code intelligence.

items.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.one_liner: Comprehensive AI engineering learning path from basics to production deployment
items.pain_point: Developers lack structured, practical AI/ML skills to build production-ready applications; companies pay for talent
app_ideas: AI-powered document processor with OCR and summarization (legal/HR use case)
Custom vision API service for e-commerce product tagging and search
AI agent framework for automating customer support workflows
items.monetization: Freemium (free learning content, paid certifications) or B2B enterprise training contracts
items.why_now: AI engineering roles growing 340% YoY, every company needs AI-integrated products now

items.name: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.one_liner: Unified API gateway for switching between 290+ AI models seamlessly.
items.pain_point: Developers face fragmented model APIs, high costs, and rate limits; enterprise teams would pay for centralized cost-tracking and reliability.
app_ideas: AI-powered cost-optimization dashboard for engineering teams to track token spend across providers.
A 'Model-Agnostic' IDE extension that automatically switches providers when one hits rate limits.
A privacy-focused proxy service that scrubs PII from prompts before sending to external LLMs.
items.monetization: B2B SaaS subscription for enterprise-grade analytics, team management, and usage governance.
items.why_now: Rapid proliferation of high-quality open-weights models makes model-agnostic infrastructure essential for stability.

items.name: stablyai/orca
items.one_liner: Orchestration platform for deploying and managing fleets of autonomous coding agents.
items.pain_point: Developers struggle to manage, monitor, and scale multiple AI agents across different environments; enterprise teams will pay for centralized control.
app_ideas: A dashboard for monitoring agent token usage and task completion across local and VPS instances.
A specialized 'Agent-as-a-Service' wrapper for specific coding workflows like automated PR reviews.
A mobile-first notification and approval gateway for triggering long-running agentic coding tasks.
items.monetization: B2B SaaS subscription for team-based agent orchestration and management.
items.why_now: The shift from single-prompt LLMs to multi-agent autonomous workflows requires standardized infrastructure.
